reason: We already have a Brita at home and our tap water is fine, so filtering inside the bottle solves a problem I don't really have. Paying $68 up front and signing up for another filter subscription is exactly the kind of thing I've learned to avoid.
objection: It's a subscription dressed up as a water bottle. I've been burned by stuff that says cancel any time and then isn't, and I don't need filtered water on the go when my tap water is fine.
would_change_my_mind: Selling the bottle at the $39.99 price without a plan, with filters as one-off purchases, and free shipping, so there's nothing to cancel later.
